words.etymology: 来自拉丁语 agere（做）+ -tion 后缀

meanings.definition: 行动，行为；作用，功能；战斗，军事行动；诉讼，法律程序；情节，故事

examples: We need to take action before it is too late.
The government has taken decisive action.
words.definition: n. 行动，行为；作用，功能；战斗，军事行动；诉讼，法律程序；情节，故事 v. 行动，表现；起作用

words.etymology: 来自拉丁语 agere（做）+ -ive 后缀

meanings.definition: 活跃的，积极的；主动的，有效的；现役的；语法上的主动态

examples: He is an active member of the community.
words.definition: adj. 活跃的，积极的；主动的，有效的；现役的 n. 主动语态；积极分子

words.etymology: 来自拉丁语 agere（做）+ re-前缀

meanings.definition: 反应，回应；起化学反应；抗拒，反抗

examples: How did she react to the news?
The market reacted strongly to the announcement.
words.definition: v. 反应，回应；起化学反应；抗拒，反抗
